concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A complex costume-photography concept set in a glass-enclosed hangar passage just after rain. The photograph shows an adult fictional woman, a model using the supplied reference, wearing a generic sage-green one-piece flight suit with a zipped center front, long sleeves, separate chest and thigh utility pockets, and a defined waist belt. Her face and short dark bob follow the supplied reference image: dark eyes, gently curved brows, wispy parted fringe, and the rounded jaw-length hair silhouette. The garment construction is visibly readable. Her sage cloth coverall runs uninterrupted from the shoulders across the belted waist into two separate trouser legs; its clearly bounded center-front zip closes that same continuous garment. Beside a waist-height brushed-metal service cart, her right thumb and index finger pinch a corner of folded white linen on the flat tray while her left hand rests on the near cart rim; both wrists connect visibly to her sleeves. Her weight rests evenly on two planted feet, and the long trouser legs end at ankle cuffs above plain dark boots. She glances toward the camera with quiet ease while finishing this small adjustment. Rain beads and a faint wet reflection remain on the glass behind her; a hangar door recedes in the background. Cool window light crosses the sage fabric from one side, while a small warm wall lamp gives a soft amber edge to the metal tray and her hair. The matte woven flight-suit fabric, crisp linen, brushed metal, and translucent wet glass have distinct surfaces. A front three-quarter full-length environmental portrait keeps the zipper, waist, pocket boundaries, both hands, and boots legible, with the face leading and the linen gesture reading second. The clothing is a generic fictional aviation costume.
